```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Data Manipulation
library(tidyverse)

# Modeling
library(tidymodels)
library(xgboost)
library(vip)
library(doParallel)
library(probably)

# SQL
library(RPostgres)

# Load Functions
source("../utils.R")

wd <- getwd()
set.seed(1015)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(Postgres(),
                 user = "postgres",
                 host = "localhost",
                 db = "baseball-research")

training_sql <- "SELECT * FROM statcast_pitching_dev WHERE game_year >= 2022 AND game_type = 'R'"

data_train <- dbGetQuery(con, training_sql)
```

```{r data-processing}
processed_data_train <- create_advance_metrics(data_train)
```

```{r}
pitching_processed <- processed_data_train |>
  mutate(swing = case_when(description %in% swing_list ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ 0),
         whiff = case_when(description %in% whiff_list ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ 0),
         foul = case_when(description %in% foul_list ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ 0),
         bip = launch_speed_angle,
         called_strike = case_when(description == 'called_strike' ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ 0),
         hbp = case_when(description == 'hit_by_pitch' ~ TRUE, TRUE ~ 0))
```

```{r}
vprocessedData = pitching_processed |>
  filter(pitch_group == "Offspeed")

# Swing-filtered data for Whiff/Foul/BIP models
model_data_swing = vprocessedData |>
  filter(swing == 1) |>
  select(pitcher, game_date, pitch_name, is_lhh, p_throws,
         plate_x, plate_z,
         sz_top, sz_bot, dist_from_mid,
         swing, whiff, foul, bip, called_strike, hbp)

# All-pitch data for CalledStrike/HBP models
model_data_all = vprocessedData |>
  select(pitcher, game_date, pitch_name, is_lhh, p_throws,
         plate_x, plate_z,
         sz_top, sz_bot, dist_from_mid,
         swing, whiff, foul, bip, called_strike, hbp)

model_data_swing_rhp = model_data_swing |>
  filter(p_throws == 1) |>
  rowid_to_column("ID") |>
  select(-c(p_throws, game_date, pitch_name, pitcher))

model_data_swing_lhp = model_data_swing |>
  filter(p_throws == 0) |>
  rowid_to_column("ID") |>
  select(-c(p_throws, game_date, pitch_name, pitcher))

model_data_all_rhp = model_data_all |>
  filter(p_throws == 1) |>
  rowid_to_column("ID") |>
  select(-c(p_throws, game_date, pitch_name, pitcher))

model_data_all_lhp = model_data_all |>
  filter(p_throws == 0) |>
  rowid_to_column("ID") |>
  select(-c(p_throws, game_date, pitch_name, pitcher))
```

```{r}
modelPrep = function(dataFrame, outcomeType){
  if (outcomeType == "Whiff"){
    data = dataFrame |>
      mutate(label = as.factor(whiff)) |>
      select(-c(ID, swing, whiff, foul, bip, called_strike, hbp))

  } else if (outcomeType == "Foul"){
    data = dataFrame |>
      mutate(label = as.factor(foul)) |>
      select(-c(ID, swing, whiff, foul, bip, called_strike, hbp))

  } else if (outcomeType == "BIP"){
    data = dataFrame |>
      filter(bip != 0) |>
      mutate(label = as.factor(bip - 1)) |>
      select(-c(ID, swing, whiff, foul, bip, called_strike, hbp))

  } else if (outcomeType == "CalledStrike"){
    data = dataFrame |>
      mutate(label = as.factor(called_strike)) |>
      select(-c(ID, swing, whiff, foul, bip, called_strike, hbp))

  } else if (outcomeType == "HBP"){
    data = dataFrame |>
      mutate(label = as.factor(hbp)) |>
      select(-c(ID, swing, whiff, foul, bip, called_strike, hbp))

  } else {
    print("Invalid Outcome Type: (Whiff, Foul, BIP, CalledStrike, HBP)")
    stop()
  }
}
```

```{r}
RHP_OS_Whiff_Data = modelPrep(model_data_swing_rhp, "Whiff")
RHP_OS_Foul_Data = modelPrep(model_data_swing_rhp, "Foul")
RHP_OS_BIP_Data = modelPrep(model_data_swing_rhp, "BIP")

LHP_OS_Whiff_Data = modelPrep(model_data_swing_lhp, "Whiff")
LHP_OS_Foul_Data = modelPrep(model_data_swing_lhp, "Foul")
LHP_OS_BIP_Data = modelPrep(model_data_swing_lhp, "BIP")

RHP_OS_CS_Data = modelPrep(model_data_all_rhp, "CalledStrike")
RHP_OS_HBP_Data = modelPrep(model_data_all_rhp, "HBP")

LHP_OS_CS_Data = modelPrep(model_data_all_lhp, "CalledStrike")
LHP_OS_HBP_Data = modelPrep(model_data_all_lhp, "HBP")
```

```{r}
train_classification_model(RHP_OS_Whiff_Data, "rhp_os_loc_whiff", tune_no_improve = 25)
train_classification_model(RHP_OS_Foul_Data, "rhp_os_loc_foul", tune_no_improve = 25)
train_multi_classification_model(RHP_OS_BIP_Data, "rhp_os_loc_bip", tune_no_improve = 25)

train_classification_model(LHP_OS_Whiff_Data, "lhp_os_loc_whiff", tune_no_improve = 25)
train_classification_model(LHP_OS_Foul_Data, "lhp_os_loc_foul", tune_no_improve = 25)
train_multi_classification_model(LHP_OS_BIP_Data, "lhp_os_loc_bip", tune_no_improve = 25)

train_classification_model(RHP_OS_CS_Data, "rhp_os_loc_cs", tune_no_improve = 25)
train_classification_model(RHP_OS_HBP_Data, "rhp_os_loc_hbp", tune_no_improve = 25)

train_classification_model(LHP_OS_CS_Data, "lhp_os_loc_cs", tune_no_improve = 25)
train_classification_model(LHP_OS_HBP_Data, "lhp_os_loc_hbp", tune_no_improve = 25)
```
